name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs, preserves Season 0 coordinates, and shows an informational No Episode on Source result when Re:ANIME has a matching catalog record explicitly marked as not watchable.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Production WCO provider with proven wcostream.tv → wcoflix.tv → wcoforever.net frontend fallback coverage for episodes, movies, and Season 0 specials; Episode 0 and fractional-special fallbacks; corrected Dub/Sub/original audio classification; and explicit-only mirror labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: WCO Power Rangers Nexus
scrapers.description: Nexus-only validation of a lightweight generic WCO season-title resolver. It derives search titles from TMDB show + season metadata, strips trailing continuation markers such as (2)/(3) into source-season hints, scores cleaned WCO episode titles without Season/Episode prefixes, keeps name and numeric matching inside the hinted source season when available, conditionally retries compact spelling, and can fall back to direct /anime/<slug>/ pages when WCO search is empty. Inline diagnostics remain available when playback resolution fails. Production WCO is untouched.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus generic season-title resolver test

scrapers.name: AnikotoTV
scrapers.description: AnikotoTV with standardized DUB/SOFTSUB/DUB+SUBS output labels based on the provider's existing selectable caption tracks.
